scope: Controlled self-collected synthetic E2E alignment baseline; not official InferenceX measurements or model-wide accuracy qualification.
hardware: 8x NVIDIA B300, single node, TP8, BF16 weights/KV, FP32 recurrent state
functional_fix: 6618b91 corrects full-block Mamba align checkpoint publication: a cold 2B prefill must not invent a B state checkpoint. Boundary smoke and full campaign pass after the fix.
limitations: FlashInfer context timing currently prefers a decode-labelled donor lane with sparse ISL=1 measurements; long prefill extrapolation is severely inflated. No timing source or numerical result was fitted to this campaign.
Some attention/GDN/BF16 MoE timing donors are vLLM 0.30.0; the runtime and requested database identity are 0.31.0. Full table hashes are in timing-data-provenance.json.
Server FlashInfer allreduce initialization hit an AF_UNIX socket-path limit and used its TRTLLM fallback. Per-message allreduce dispatch parity is unverified.
Observed client encoding/transport/detokenization remain in client latency; simulated lane launches are simultaneous. Maximum observed initial dispatch spread was 28.171 ms.
Cold/warm initial prompts match, but 930 of 1008 paired turns differ in realized tokens. Each trajectory is replayed independently; this is not a pure cache-effect ablation.
Synthetic linear chains with repeated tool-token padding; no semantic task-quality score or real AgentX trace representativeness claim.
No cache pressure, eviction, preemption, MTP, fine-grained prefix matching, offload, P/D, multi-node, branch/join or FPM-step accuracy qualification.
Native agentic capability qualification remains functional_only; timing uses the actual op_level estimator, but agentic timing accuracy is not qualified.
next_timing_fix: Choose FlashInfer measurement sources by actual query length and runtime dispatch: multi-token prefill versus one-token decode/APC tails. Preserve version priority and rerun these unchanged traces.
